summary: Frontend QA pass after signup-route rename, magazine-style notes redesign, 5-question quiz/interview cap, and module-project gate fix. Verified routing, login, dashboard rendering, session page, quiz-start cap. Could NOT exhaustively verify the new magazine-style notes cards / interview-cap / simulations / module-project gate because testagent2026 has only Session 1 (Time Value of Money) with notes phase completed; quiz/interview/simulation phases for S1 are locked until prerequisites complete, and S7/S11/S13 (the regenerated sessions main agent flagged) belong to later modules that are not yet unlocked for this user. Direct deep-link navigation to /session/<master_session_id>/notes returns a Supabase 406 (Cannot coerce to single JSON object) because NotesPage queries user_sessions by id, not master_sessions — so the session ids quoted in the request (e.g. 9559a9ba... for S7) cannot be opened directly without seeding a user_sessions row.

integration_issues.issue: If <id> is not a valid user_sessions row id for the logged-in user, NotesPage shows 'Couldn’t load notes — Cannot coerce the result to a single JSON object' instead of a friendly 404 / not-enrolled message. Repro: log in as testagent2026, visit /session/9559a9ba-a909-4f8c-9346-4219bf23852a/notes (S7 master id from the request). Two Supabase 406 calls fire against user_sessions. Recommend either a) replace .single() with .maybeSingle() and surface a clearer 'session not unlocked yet' state, or b) accept master_session_id and resolve to the per-user row server-side.

issues: Skeleton loaders remain visible for ~8–12 seconds before content (continue-learning-card, dashboard-module-timeline, dashboard-capstone) appears. No console errors, no failed network calls — just slow due to 8 sequential Supabase queries (profiles → enrollments → user_modules → user_stats → user_sessions → user_capstone_projects → user_module_projects). Consider parallelising independent queries with Promise.all or a single RPC, otherwise dashboard feels janky on every load.

rca of the issue: The 'NotesPage 406' error reproduced via direct deep-link is not a regression — it's a result of the URL convention: NotesPage.jsx line 1489-1495 does supabase.from('user_sessions').select('*').eq('id', sessionId).single(). When a master_session_id is passed, no row matches and Supabase returns 406 with PostgREST 'Cannot coerce the result to a single JSON object'. Fix: use .maybeSingle() and render an explicit 'This session is not unlocked yet' state, OR add a redirect that resolves master_session_id→user_sessions.id for the current user before loading.
